1352.1: There is one God, Ik Oankar, the One who pervades all and is ever the same; his Name is Sat (the One who truly is); he is the Creator, the Being who dwells in all, without fear, without enmity, his form beyond time, unborn, self-existent, realised by the Guru's grace. Raag Jaijavanti, by the Ninth Guru (Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji). Remember Ram, remember Ram: this alone will be of use to you. Give up the company of Maya; take refuge in God. Know the pleasures of the world to be false; all this show is false. Know wealth to be like a dream; on what do you pride yourself? The rule of the earth is like a wall of sand. Servant Nanak tells (you) this: your body will perish. As yesterday went by, moment by moment, so today is going. ॥2॥
1352.2: Raag Jaijavanti, by the Ninth Guru (Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji). Worship Ram, worship Ram; (your) life is running out. How often am I to tell you? Why do you not understand, O fool? (Your) body is like a hailstone: it takes no time to perish. Cast off all doubts; take the Name of Gobind (the Lord of the universe). At the very end this one (Name) alone goes with you. Forget Maya as (you would) poison; hold God's praise in (your) heart. Servant Nanak calls out aloud: the time (of life) is slipping away. ॥2॥
1352.3: Raag Jaijavanti, by the Ninth Guru (Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji). O mind, what will become of you? In this world (the one support) is the Name of Ram, and that you have not heard with your ears. You are greatly lured by the objects of the senses, and have not turned your mind (from them). You took birth as a human, (yet) did not do Simran for even an instant. You became a slave to the pleasures of a wife, and fetters (of attachment) have fallen on your feet. Servant Nanak calls out aloud: the expanse of the world is like a dream. Why do you not remember Murari, whose handmaid Maya is? ॥2॥
Murari (the foe of the demon Mur): a name of God.
1352.4: Raag Jaijavanti, by the Ninth Guru (Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji). Your life will pass, will pass, to no purpose, O man. Night and day you hear the Puranas, yet you do not understand, O ignorant one. Death has already arrived; where will you flee, O man? The body you have held to be lasting, that (body) of yours will become dust. Why do you not take the Lord's Name, O shameless fool? Bring devotion to Ram into (your) heart, and give up the pride of (your) mind. Servant Nanak declares this: (so) dwell in the world (with honour), O man. ॥2॥
